paper.title: Layout Optimization for Maximizing Wind Farm Power Production Using Sequential Convex Programming

public_source.publisher_manuscript: legally consumed through Elsevier API; not redistributed

paper_problem.wake_model: continuous Gaussian radial deficit, rotor-disc average and root-sum-square multiple wakes

method.objective_gradient: fixed-width forward automatic differentiation of the paper equations
method.qp_backend: pinned open NLopt SLSQP in place of unpublished CVX

declared_completions.geometry: Figure-10 digitization: 7D basis, 97.35-degree row orientation, diagonal rounding to reported 10.4D
declared_completions.rotor_integration: four equal-area radial annuli by sixteen midpoint azimuths

paper_conflicts.resolution: use 8.15-11.50 as scale and 2.05-2.81 as shape; preserve this declaration

formal_protocol.reason: the paper SCP/CVX procedure is deterministic and reports no stochastic repeats

parallel_regions: all 160 forward derivatives inside each independent term
hpc.determinism: fixed task-index output followed by ordered reduction

claim_boundary: Academic paper-equation reconstruction; not author CVX/SCP, exact Horns Rev coordinates, SOWFA/CFD replay, or exact numerical replay.
